A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

apple polyphenols have the ability to modulate several cellular mechanisms involved in mucosal protection and repair, and that these effects may be mediated by the activation of several signalling cascades.
the use of apple polyphenols as nutraceuticals may be a promising strategy for the protection of gastrointestinal mucosa.

The main takeaway from our work is that
nutraceuticals, and in particular apple extracts, can be used to protect and heal the gastrointestinal mucosa.

apple polyphenols are effective in preventing and healing mucosal damage, and that this effect may be related to their ability to modulate intestinal permeability, to stimulate the production of mucin by goblet cells, and to inhibit the activity of pro-inflammatory cytokines.

the use of apple extracts may have beneficial effects on gastrointestinal mucosal integrity and healing, and may be used as an alternative to conventional therapies in the treatment of gastrointestinal disorders.
